headline: River Access and Campground Reservation Guidelines
reservation: Camping within the National Recreation Area requires advance booking through official federal platforms; river primitive campsites have specific arrival rules. Daily amenity fees apply at certain expanded sites like Smithfield Beach; check the official NPS site for the current reservation status of trails and parking.

days.title: New Jersey Ridges

stops.name: Mount Tammany
stops.detail: Ascend the Red Dot Trail for the signature view overlooking the Gap and the Delaware River.

stops.name: Old Mine Road
stops.detail: Drive sections of one of the oldest commercial roads in the US to see historic copper mine sites.

days.driving: Allow 60–90 minutes; mountain roads are narrow and seasonal closures are frequent.
days.note: Parking at Dunnfield Creek fills very early on weekends.

days.title: Pennsylvania Waterfalls

stops.name: Dingmans Falls
stops.detail: Walk the boardwalk trail to see the second highest waterfall in Pennsylvania.

stops.name: Raymondskill Falls
stops.detail: Visit the three-tiered cascade, which is the tallest waterfall in the state.

days.driving: Allow 60–80 minutes; local bridge crossings between NJ and PA may have weight limits.
days.note: Check NPS alerts for seasonal boardwalk maintenance or ice closures.

days.title: River Corridors
days.start: Suggested: 8:30 AM from Delaware Water Gap Borough

stops.name: McDade Recreational Trail
stops.detail: Hike or bike this multi-use path that parallels the river and passes through diverse habitats.

stops.name: Smithfield Beach
stops.detail: Utilize the river access for a designated swimming area or boat launch point.

days.driving: Allow 30–50 minutes; river levels can impact road access near the banks.
days.note: Life jackets are required for all river activities; check current water quality advisories.

intel.title: Trailhead Congestion
intel.text: Popular lots like Mount Tammany frequently reach capacity by 9 AM; have a secondary destination ready.

intel.title: Gorge Dead Zones
intel.text: Cellular reception is extremely limited within the deep gorge and along river-level trails; download maps offline.

intel.title: Gateway Supplies
intel.text: Refuel in Stroudsburg or Blairstown; there are no gas stations within the Recreation Area boundaries.

intel.title: Peak Foliage
intel.text: Mid-October brings heavy traffic for leaf-peeping; mid-week visits offer a significantly quieter experience.

intel.title: River Conditions
intel.text: High water levels may close launch sites; always check the river stage via official USGS or NPS links.

plan.arrival: Fly into Lehigh Valley (ABE) and drive north; Stroudsburg provides the most comprehensive grocery and supply options.
plan.vehicle: Standard vehicles are fine for main routes; check rental terms for driving on unpaved portions of Old Mine Road.
plan.goldenHour: Mount Minsi provides an eastern-facing view for sunrise over the Gap; allow for seasonal light shifts.
